svg.title: Molecule of the day: Atenolol
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Atenolol while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as -0.44.
svg.text: MW 266.3 · cLogP 0.45 · TPSA 84.6 · HBD 3 · HBA 4 · RotB 8
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
